line: Crowley on Atu VI: Gemini under Mercury, the letter Zain, the path from Binah to Tiphareth, and the Royal Marriage (pdf p27, p70, p71, p72, p92, p211).

sections.title: Sign and letter
sections.line: Crowley on Gemini, ruled by Mercury, and the letter Zain, and on the first card in which more than one figure appears (pdf p70).

quotes.quote: Atu VI refers to Gemini, ruled by Mercury. It means The Twins. The Hebrew letter corresponding is Zain, which means a Sword,
It is the first card in which more than one figure appears.

sections.title: From Binah to Tiphareth

quotes.quote: Gemini leads from Binah to Tiphareth.

sections.title: Analysis and Synthesis
sections.line: Crowley on the subject of the card, Analysis followed by Synthesis (pdf p71), and on the Royal Marriage that took place in Atu VI (pdf p92).

quotes.quote: The subject of this card is Analysis, followed by Synthesis.
This card represents the Consummation of the Royal Marriage which took place in Atu VI.
